purpose: Machine-readable candidate register for brain-body interface protocol rows used by the disembodied-cns domain. It supports variable governance and auditability only; it does not establish engineering feasibility, clinical validity, personal survival or operational use.

protocolRows.exchange_content: blood flow, perfusion pressure, oxygen delivery support and microcirculation proxies
protocolRows.unit_or_scale: pressure, flow, oxygenation and tissue-integrity proxies; exact disembodied subject scale not specified
protocolRows.latency_bound: low-latency continuous support required; exact bound not specified
protocolRows.precision_requirement: bounded physiological stability; no subject-continuity precision threshold established
protocolRows.error_tolerance: loss of perfusion, severe instability, uncontrolled edema, thrombosis, hemorrhage or infection triggers abort/block
protocolRows.closed_loop_role: substrate maintenance for neural tissue and downstream cognition
protocolRows.abort_gate: Cannot claim subject continuity from tissue viability, perfusion signal or partial cellular recovery alone.
protocolRows.scope_boundary: Supports substrate-maintenance and protocol-field modeling only; does not support revival, consciousness recovery, personal survival or deployable life-support engineering.

protocolRows.exchange_content: heartbeat, respiration, pain, fatigue, hunger, temperature, visceral state and affect-relevant internal-body signals
protocolRows.carrier: neural and humoral signaling; artificial replacement not specified
protocolRows.unit_or_scale: subjective reports, physiological proxies, neural proxies and affective stability indicators
protocolRows.latency_bound: task- and state-dependent; exact bound not specified
protocolRows.precision_requirement: sufficient to preserve emotion, self-regulation, action readiness and agency; exact threshold not specified
protocolRows.error_tolerance: severe signal loss, false body state, affective instability, dissociation or impaired agency triggers block/cannot-evaluate
protocolRows.closed_loop_role: emotion, self-model, motivation, risk perception and regulatory feedback
protocolRows.abort_gate: Cannot treat oxygenated neural substrate maintenance as sufficient if interoceptive feedback and embodied regulation collapse.
protocolRows.scope_boundary: Conceptual and variable-modeling support only; no artificial interoception engineering claim and no subject-continuity proof.

protocolRows.exchange_content: oxygen, glucose, energy substrates and energy-availability signals required for neural tissue maintenance
protocolRows.carrier: vascular flow, extracorporeal oxygenation and metabolic support candidate
protocolRows.unit_or_scale: oxygenation, glucose, perfusion, tissue-integrity and metabolic-marker proxies; exact subject-continuity scale not specified
protocolRows.latency_bound: low-latency continuous supply required; exact disembodied bound not specified
protocolRows.precision_requirement: bounded substrate availability without severe hypo/hyper state; no identity-continuity threshold established
protocolRows.error_tolerance: severe oxygen or glucose instability, ischemia, metabolic crisis or uncontrolled support-device failure triggers abort/block
protocolRows.closed_loop_role: substrate supply for neural activity, consciousness candidates and downstream cognitive function
protocolRows.abort_gate: Cannot claim subject continuity from oxygen/glucose support or neural tissue substrate maintenance alone.
protocolRows.scope_boundary: Supports substrate-supply and closed-loop-control vocabulary only; does not support deployable metabolic life-support engineering or personal survival claims.

protocolRows.exchange_content: carbon dioxide, lactate, acid-base state, electrolytes, nitrogenous waste and other metabolic waste proxies
protocolRows.carrier: blood chemistry, extracorporeal circulation and organ-support candidate
protocolRows.unit_or_scale: blood-gas, electrolyte, acid-base and metabolic-waste proxies; disembodied subject thresholds not specified
protocolRows.frequency_or_cadence: continuous / periodic monitoring depending on variable
protocolRows.latency_bound: variable-specific; exact closed-loop control bound not specified
protocolRows.precision_requirement: bounded internal milieu stability sufficient to avoid neural dysfunction; exact threshold not specified
protocolRows.error_tolerance: uncontrolled acidosis, electrolyte collapse, toxin accumulation, edema, device failure or unbounded waste load triggers block/cannot-evaluate
protocolRows.closed_loop_role: protects neural substrate and whole-system homeostasis from waste and internal-environment drift
protocolRows.abort_gate: Cannot treat metabolic clearance proxies as sufficient unless failure modes, timing and neural-state consequences are bounded.
protocolRows.scope_boundary: Only supports clearance-channel modeling; does not prove long-term artificial homeostasis, clinical deployability or subject continuity.

protocolRows.exchange_content: hormonal regulation signals including glucose regulation, stress-axis proxies, circadian signals and metabolic endocrine state
protocolRows.carrier: humoral signaling and sensor-algorithm-actuator loop candidates
protocolRows.unit_or_scale: hormone or endocrine proxy values, time-in-range style endpoints and rhythm stability proxies
protocolRows.frequency_or_cadence: multi-timescale, from rapid glucose control to circadian and stress rhythms
protocolRows.latency_bound: variable-specific; exact multi-axis endocrine replacement bound not specified
protocolRows.precision_requirement: sufficient to preserve metabolic regulation, stress response, affect and action readiness; exact threshold not specified
protocolRows.error_tolerance: sensor drift, algorithm error, actuator failure, endocrine crisis, rhythm collapse or user/subject non-expression triggers block/cannot-evaluate
protocolRows.closed_loop_role: regulates internal state, energy allocation, stress response and body-brain state prediction
protocolRows.abort_gate: Cannot generalize a single endocrine closed loop into whole-body endocrine replacement or subject-continuity support.
protocolRows.scope_boundary: Supports local closed-loop endocrine substitution vocabulary only; does not prove multi-axis endocrine replacement, subject continuity or medical advice.

protocolRows.exchange_content: immune activation, inflammation, infection, tissue injury and public-health-risk signals affecting neural and systemic state
protocolRows.carrier: humoral immune signaling, tissue state, implanted or transplanted biological material and monitoring system candidates
protocolRows.unit_or_scale: inflammatory marker proxies, infection-risk proxies, rejection-risk proxies and monitoring requirements
protocolRows.latency_bound: risk- and event-dependent; exact disembodied bound not specified
protocolRows.precision_requirement: sufficient to detect infection, inflammatory drift, rejection and public-health risk before irreversible subject harm
protocolRows.error_tolerance: uncontrolled infection, rejection, inflammation, zoonotic risk, surveillance failure or monitoring loss triggers block/abort
protocolRows.closed_loop_role: protects substrate, replacement components and social/public-health boundary from immune and infection failure
protocolRows.abort_gate: Cannot treat biological replacement material as stable subject infrastructure without immune, infection, monitoring and public-health boundaries.
protocolRows.scope_boundary: Only supports immune/inflammatory risk-channel modeling; does not prove xenotransplantation safety, whole-body replacement or long-term subject preservation.

protocolRows.exchange_content: visual, auditory, tactile, proprioceptive, vestibular and environment-state inputs needed for world-model updating
protocolRows.carrier: sensory organs, neural stimulation, implanted BCI, external sensors or virtual-environment candidates
protocolRows.unit_or_scale: sensory bandwidth, classification accuracy, signal stability, latency and functional endpoint proxies
protocolRows.latency_bound: task-dependent; closed-loop agency requires bounded latency but exact threshold not specified
protocolRows.precision_requirement: sufficient to preserve perception, orientation, learning, feedback and agency; exact threshold not specified
protocolRows.error_tolerance: signal loss, sensory hallucination, unstable stimulation, unsafe latency or incoherent body/environment feedback triggers block/cannot-evaluate
protocolRows.closed_loop_role: feeds world state into cognition, learning, safety behavior and embodied self-model
protocolRows.abort_gate: Cannot infer high-bandwidth whole-body sensory replacement from limited BCI or sensory-interface research.
protocolRows.scope_boundary: Supports sensory-interface variable modeling only; does not prove whole-body sensory substitution, stable embodied cognition or deployable BCI replacement.

protocolRows.exchange_content: language, eye movement, action intention, motor command, external actuator control and expressive output
protocolRows.carrier: motor pathways, neural decoding, implanted BCI and external actuator candidates
protocolRows.unit_or_scale: functional endpoint, command accuracy, latency, reliability, fatigue and safety-event proxies
protocolRows.latency_bound: task- and safety-dependent; exact subject-continuity bound not specified
protocolRows.precision_requirement: sufficient to preserve communication, consent, action, correction and social participation; exact threshold not specified
protocolRows.error_tolerance: loss of expression, unsafe actuator command, decoding drift, agency mismatch or inability to withdraw consent triggers block/abort
protocolRows.closed_loop_role: allows subject expression, action, feedback correction, consent and participation in the environment
protocolRows.abort_gate: Cannot claim subject continuity if the system cannot support reliable expression, correction, refusal and agency boundaries.
protocolRows.scope_boundary: Supports output-interface and agency-boundary modeling only; does not prove stable long-term motor replacement, personhood preservation or engineering feasibility.

protocolRows.exchange_content: consent, withdrawal, refusal, preference expression, identity continuity, delegation, audit trail and legal/ethical control signals
protocolRows.carrier: communication interface, governance record, device software controls, human review and safety-case process
protocolRows.unit_or_scale: auditability, traceability, consent-state, withdrawal path, expression reliability and reviewer-signoff proxies
protocolRows.frequency_or_cadence: continuous availability with event-driven governance actions
protocolRows.latency_bound: must support timely stop/withdraw/refusal pathways; exact bound not specified
protocolRows.precision_requirement: sufficient to avoid misattributed identity, coerced continuation, unauthorized operation and unverifiable subject preference
protocolRows.error_tolerance: loss of consent channel, unverifiable identity, unsafe automation, missing audit trail or governance override triggers block/abort
protocolRows.closed_loop_role: keeps the system accountable to the subject as a rights-bearing agent rather than a maintained biological object
protocolRows.abort_gate: Cannot treat a maintained CNS substrate as a continuing subject if expression, consent, refusal, auditability and identity boundaries are absent.
protocolRows.scope_boundary: Governance and safety-case vocabulary only; does not establish legal personhood, clinical operation, subject survival or deployable control architecture.
